title: 6,720 In 30 Minutes! BEST New MOB XP Farm Minecraft 1.21+
description: In this tutorial, I’ll show you how to build a new mob xp farm in minecraft, this farm can produce a crazy amount of loot in a few minutes and it can produce 34 level of xp in 1 minute and 33 seconds, it is expandable and it is is redstoneless it uses only one dispenser and uses a simple clock that based off boat farm uses gnembon platform tech for layers and on each layer i used tunnels to get water over all floors without using a single observer, which makes this farm the easiest, cheapest and fastest mob xp farm in minecraft!
